label: Bass up close, drums wide
why: Pulling the bass in front of you makes the groove the star.

label: Just drums and bass
why: Strip it to the rhythm section to hear how tight the funk is.

label: Dub echo on the lead
why: A tempo-synced echo makes the lead line bounce around the room.

label: Muffled guitar far away
why: Darkening the guitar and pushing it back leaves room for the bass.

label: Half-time bass
why: Slowing just the bass gives the groove a lazy, heavy feel.

label: Loop the opening phrase
why: Repeating the first section turns it into a beat to play over.
